subject: ClearPay deletion request — prompt/output/log purge & confirmation
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@clearpay.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: privacy@clearpay.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0500
Subject: ClearPay: request to purge prompts/outputs/logs (tenant CLP-6421)

Hi Stephanie,

We need Redwood to execute a full purge for our tenant (CLP-6421) covering the following artefacts:
- Prompt inputs and generated outputs associated with customer identifiers (tokens starting CP-*)
- Inference logs (request/response KV cache traces, request metadata) stored since 2025-11-01
- Any derived embeddings and short-lived diagnostic traces in dev/test environments linked to CLP-6421

We have an internal compliance window and would like completion confirmation and provenance evidence (manifest and Ops ticket) within 7 business days if possible. Please confirm:
1) What exact scopes you'll remove (prod/dev/test)
2) Expected start/finish dates and any downtime or service impact
3) Evidence artifacts you'll provide after completion (manifest CSV, ops ticket, screenshots, signed attestation)

We can sign any standard Mutual Action Plan (MPA) or Data Erasure Agreement you require — attaching a short intake (privacy@clearpay.com) if helpful.

Thanks,

Sanjay Rao
Privacy Officer, ClearPay
S: +1 415 555 0199
privacy@clearpay.com

- Inference logs: request/response payloads, KV cache fragments, and associated metadata in both prod and any linked staging clusters flagged to CLP-6421
- Derived vectors/embeddings associated with the tenant in our feature-store index

Proposed schedule:
- Intake & signed MPA received by 2026-12-10 EOD
- Ops purge window: 2026-12-13 02:00–04:00 UTC (no customer-facing downtime expected)
- Evidence delivery: within 24 hours after ops window

Evidence artifacts we will provide:
- erase-manifest-CLP-6421.csv (record ids + removed flags + sha256 proofs)
- ops ticket and timeline (Redwood ticket #98765)
- screenshots of ledger/ops console and audit log extracts
- signed Redwood attestation PDF if required

Action items for ClearPay: please confirm acceptance of the scope and MPA attachment, and confirm whether staging clusters are in scope. Also confirm whether your legal team needs a DocuSign flow (we can supply).

Attaching our intake checklist to speed things up.
